entities.summary: Oligarchic Republic and Export Boom, a transformative movement in Argentina (1880–1900). Emerged from Buenos Aires federalized as national capital. Catalyzed Tango emerges from Buenos Aires working-class neighborhoods 1880s–1900s and Argentina becomes world's leading grain and beef exporter by 1900.
